faqs.question: Who is Mohd Elfie Nieshaem Juferi?
faqs.answer: A Malaysian writer, Muslim apologist, SEO specialist and developer based in Kuala Lumpur. He publishes Malay literature and comparative religion under Langgam Fikir Enterprise and is a co-founder and executive editor of Bismika Allahuma.

faqs.question: What does he write about?
faqs.answer: Comparative religion, principally Islam, Christianity and Judaism, along with Malay poetry and prose. He has been published since 1995 and has five books to date.

faqs.question: What is Ibn Juferi al-Amriki?
faqs.answer: His pen name, used for work in comparative religion since 1999. It is the same person, not a separate author.

faqs.question: What is Langgam Fikir Enterprise?
faqs.answer: His independent imprint in Seri Kembangan, Selangor, publishing his own titles in literature, history, ideas and religious discourse.

faqs.question: Where is the full biographical record?
faqs.answer: At menj.bio, a documented archive of works, qualifications, records, media and sources, which also holds the authoritative identity record.

faqs.question: How should he be cited?
faqs.answer: As Mohd Elfie Nieshaem Juferi, with a link to the page quoted. Attribution is required for reuse.

developer.platform: Static site, no CMS and no database
stack: Node build script (build/render.mjs) rendering static HTML
Tailwind CSS compiled at build time
Self-hosted woff2 fonts, no third-party requests
notes: Every page is served as static HTML; nothing is assembled in the browser except the blog feed.
Structured data is a single JSON-LD @graph per page, generated from the same JSON that fills the page.
External identifiers are pulled from menj.bio/identity.json at build time.
